sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Renamed library part
sections.what: Gives the library's aspect ratio part a project name and makes it available to other files. It adds no styling or behavior of its own.
sections.why: Keeps the import path consistent across the app.
sections.watch_out: Because nothing is added here, a page that needs styling must provide it.

summary: A thin wrapper that keeps a box at a fixed width-to-height shape, such as a widescreen frame.
purpose: Lets a page keep an image or video at a set shape as the page width changes.
why: Likely reason: keeps the library part under the app's own name. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Step 1: Loads the aspect ratio part from the Radix library. Step 2: Gives it a short name. Step 3: Makes it available to other files.
inputs: Content placed inside the part and a ratio setting that the library reads.
outputs: A box that keeps its shape as the surrounding width changes.
risks: Adds nothing of its own, so any change in the library changes this part too. No default ratio is set here.
debug: If a box is the wrong shape, check the ratio setting on the page that uses this part. If the part is missing, check that the Radix package is installed.
